After the final intended transfer publication, obtain a fresh exact 86-app/2-native tip snapshot, both mains and planned archive absence. Create the one archive-only commit with the final transfer first and its exact tree. Retain actual commit/ref readback and independently accept all final tip coverage plus current native-main ancestry before forming either deletion request.

Keep refs/heads/archive/bead-editing-complete-20261127 at the exact independently accepted 32-parent archive commit until both guarded repository deletions and their remote readbacks finish. Do not advance transfer or the archive ref during that interval.

Use only the accepted fixed allowlists, current expected-tip leases and root's separately reviewed requests. Any changed tip/main/archive, timeout or uncertain result requires actual reconciliation before another mutation.

Retain actual archive/deletion evidence outside the frozen transfer interval. Later completion evidence or an archive descendant requires a separate deliberate publication after both deletion readbacks; this preparation authorizes neither.
